messages.subject: How to render the shiny UI widgets with RMarkdown ?
parts:
Hello,

 In order to make a presentation, I'd like to show all the shiny UI widgets (textInput, numericInput, ...) in a html slide. I'm using Ramnath's slidify() package with the runDeck() function to launch shiny in some slides, but I don't think I need shiny to render only the UI widgets ?

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: How to render the shiny UI widgets with RMarkdown ?
parts: Yes. That is true. You can use Shiny's UI functions to create the widgets, but don't need to put the presentation on a Shiny Server, if you only want to demo the widgets themeselves.

Le jeudi 31 octobre 2013 21:04:13 UTC+1, Ramnath Vaidyanathan a écrit :
You need a wrapper function

wrap_ui <- function(x){
  cat(as.character(x))
}


```{r results = 'asis', comment = NA}
wrap_ui(
  textInput("a", "a")
)
```

will give you


<label for="a">a</label>
<input id="a" type="text" value=""/>
